anim_set_lock.FIGHT: every move in this file: moveset moves and combat stances — the combat animation bank
anim_set_lock.SHOW: win poses, intro poses, taunts, cutscene animations — intro/win slots and cutscenes ONLY; bank clips in game/assets/anim/t3/king_on_pantera_leoman/ (t3_stance.json → intro slot, t3_win_*.json → win slots); must NEVER enter this moveset without the user's explicit approval
anim_set_lock.note: per-move 'set' tags stamp what each pull lane added; the file itself is the FIGHT set

frame_convention: T3 60fps -> seconds; damage scaled T3 170HP -> WH 100HP

generated_full_moveset.note: Full T3 bank depth merged over curated base; curated moves preserved verbatim. Largest T3 bank (652 rows, 218 attacks).

canon_note: Pantera WH signature moves preserved verbatim; T8 King frame data folded in.

forward_merge.method: semantic union of branch (moveset-cluster-a-t8) and main versions; main keeps contested move keys, branch entries rekeyed <key>_t8 with t8_input recorded; colliding branch specials appended with forward_merge_alt_of

expansion.note: Additive expansion from real T3 teardown bank rows. Existing moves untouched.

pantera_pull_20261023.by: moveset pull worker (T8 frame-data diff vs existing moveset)

merge_sources.note: Existing moves untouched. New moves carry merge_source; slots = default input map (editor can reassign any move). Damage scaled to WH 100 HP, raw in damage_raw.

string_fix_20261024.rule: WH fires each string STEP as its own attack, so a step move's runtime damage = T7 MOD damage of that step's hit (last hit of the MOD row), not the running total. Singles that fire via slots use MOD damage. T8 multi_hit.total values are left untouched as source records.

not_changed_on_purpose.1+2: WH SIGNATURE (Battle Itself) — canon move, not King's T7 1+2; MOD 24 not applied.
not_changed_on_purpose.plain T3 records (1, 2, 2,1, WS.2,2 shad: shadowed by slots; left as T3 source records.
not_changed_on_purpose.f,f,2 / f,f,1+2 held spellings: NOT added: indistinguishable from f,F+2 / f,F+1+2 in the resolver (same [f,f] dirs; held-final-direction rule picks the capital spelling). Playable forms f,f,n,2 and f,f,n,1+2 already fire.
not_changed_on_purpose.close/far proximity variants: not expressible (no proximity system): d/f+3+4 (Close), f,F+2+3 (Close), 3+4,3,2+3 (Close), f,F+1+2 (Far).
not_changed_on_purpose.spin scaling: JGS follow-ups set to 1-spin MOD values; WH has no spin counter, so 2–5-spin damage scaling is UNMAPPED.
not_changed_on_purpose.ALI.2 / ALI.1: T7 ALI row is ambiguous (18,13); left untouched, flagged UNMAPPED.
not_changed_on_purpose.d/f+4,3,4,B: direction ending, not a hit — hits already covered by d/f+4,3,4.

string_fix_20261024.animations: No string step maps to T3 row 35 (LP1+RP2 chord) or any chord row in this file (checked: t3_row is None for all T7-wired steps; animation comes from fighter.js match/donor fallback and is UNVERIFIED per move — see research doc).
string_fix_20261024.runtime_notation: Runtime keys stay 1/2/3/4 (fighter.js + movesets.js resolve on exact 1/2/3/4 strings; renaming keys to LP1/RP2 would break every lookup). input_lp is display only.
string_fix_20261024.first_hit_fix_note: First-hit singles fixed in a second pass (audit caught them): df+1, df+2, d+1, b+1, d+3+4. d+3+4 MOD variance: standalone row 18 (used), wired king_88 record 14, extended ALI row first hit 21.
